fixed_paragraph: When I walk into a room full of people, I immediately start chatting with everyone. When I hear music playing, I can't help but dance along. When someone suggests a group activity, I enthusiastically join in and encourage others to participate. When I meet someone new, I ask lots of questions to get to know them better. When I'm at a party, I love being the center of attention and telling stories. When I see someone sitting alone, I make it a point to go over and strike up a conversation. When there's a chance to lead a team, I eagerly volunteer and motivate everyone. When I have free time, I prefer to spend it with friends rather than being alone. When I encounter a challenge, I tackle it head-on with energy and optimism.
